hints.title: Order in the input does not matter
hints.body: A run is about which values exist, not where they appear. Duplicates add no new information. What data structure removes duplicates and answers 'does this value exist?' quickly?

hints.title: Find where a run starts
hints.body: A value `x` can start a run exactly when `x - 1` is absent. If `x - 1` is present, `x` is in the middle of a run and expanding from it would repeat work.

hints.title: Expand only from starts
hints.body: Put every value in a hash set. Scan the set; when `x - 1` is missing, count upward with `x + 1`, `x + 2`, and so on while those values remain in the set. Every value is visited a constant number of times.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
values = set(nums)
best = 0
for value in values:
    if value - 1 in values:
        continue
    length = 1
    while value + length in values:
        length += 1
    best = max(best, length)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Handle the empty input naturally.
